patterns.note: Full-bleed hero section featuring a prominent auto-playing video background with overlaid text and a call-to-action.
Consistent use of multi-column grid layouts for displaying product lines and categories, typically in three-column arrangements.
High-contrast design primarily using black and white for backgrounds and text, with a vibrant green used sparingly as an accent color for branding and subtle highlights.
The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport, maintaining its full size and appearance without transformation as the user scrolls.
The hero section features a video that plays continuously and scrolls out of view with the rest of the page content, without any parallax or complex scroll-triggered effects on the video itself.
Headings are consistently large, bold, and set in a clean sans-serif typeface, creating a strong visual hierarchy against smaller, legible body text.

technique_notes: A full-width, auto-playing video serves as the background for the hero section, with primary messaging and a call-to-action positioned over it, ensuring high visual impact upon page load.
The global navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element, fixed to the top of the browser window, maintaining its original dimensions and styling throughout the scroll experience.

Content sections are structured using a combination of flexible grid systems for product showcases and full-width blocks for informational content, with standard vertical scrolling revealing new sections without additional scroll-triggered animations or reveals.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual impact, complemented by smaller, uppercase labels and clear, legible body text.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced — the hero section is airy, while content grids maintain a consistent, balanced density.

standout: This site stands out with its sophisticated use of a full-bleed video hero that immediately conveys a lifestyle and brand identity, rather than just a static image. The design maintains a premium feel through a high-contrast black and white palette, allowing the product's vibrant colors and the dynamic video content to be the primary visual focus.
